It's 50-50 in the Senate with the vice president who has to break any tie. that three and a half trillion number has to get approval by nearly every Democrat with only three to spare. We've got a lot of moderate Democrats who are concerned about that price tag. We've got a lot of Democrats who are considered more progressive who want more money.
